extDescription.message: Screenshot the current tab straight to the clipboard with a hotkey.

commandDescription.message: Copy a screenshot of the visible page

optionsHotkeyHint.message: Chrome doesn't let extensions change their own shortcuts, so this opens the browser's shortcuts page. Keep the scope “In Chrome”: a global shortcut doesn't give the extension access to the page.

optionsShowToast.message: Show a notification on the page

optionsShowToastHint.message: A small “Screenshot copied” toast after each capture.

optionsDownscaleHint.message: On Retina and other high-density screens, save at CSS pixel size instead of 2× — smaller and easier to paste.
